name: webmail
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 4h16c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2v12c0 1.1-.9 2-2 2H4c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V6c0-1.1.9-2 2-2z"/><polyline points="22,6 12,13 2,6"/></svg>
description: 网页邮箱：IMAP 收件 + SMTP 发信 + 新邮件通知，可开放给 AI 直接管理邮件。
descriptionEn: Web mail: IMAP inbox + SMTP send + new-mail notifications, optionally let the AI manage mail.

name: db-client
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><ellipse cx="12" cy="5" rx="9" ry="3"/><path d="M21 12c0 1.66-4 3-9 3s-9-1.34-9-3"/><path d="M3 5v14c0 1.66 4 3 9 3s9-1.34 9-3V5"/></svg>
description: 数据库连接管理：MySQL / PostgreSQL / SQLite / SQL Server / MongoDB / Redis 的库表浏览、SQL 查询与数据编辑。
descriptionEn: Database client: browse schemas, run SQL and edit data across MySQL / PostgreSQL / SQLite / SQL Server / MongoDB / Redis.

name: vscode-editor
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m16 18 6-6-6-6"/><path d="m8 6-6 6 6 6"/></svg>
description: 类 VSCode 工作台：多根文件树 + CodeMirror 编辑器 + 底部终端 + Remote-SSH + SFTP 同步；向 AI 注册 SFTP/SSH/远端文件工具，可自主传代码。
descriptionEn: VSCode-like workbench: multi-root file tree, CodeMirror editor, integrated terminal, Remote-SSH and SFTP sync; registers SFTP/SSH/remote-file tools so the AI can deploy code itself.

name: mermaid
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="18" cy="5" r="3"/><circle cx="6" cy="12" r="3"/><circle cx="18" cy="19" r="3"/><line x1="8.59" y1="13.51" x2="15.42" y2="17.49"/><line x1="15.41" y1="6.51" x2="8.59" y2="10.49"/></svg>
description: 把对话里的 ```mermaid 围栏渲染成 SVG 图表（fenced-code 渲染插件，本地引擎离线优先）。
descriptionEn: Renders ```mermaid fences in messages to SVG diagrams (fenced-code renderer plugin, offline-first local engine).

name: run-trace
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><polyline points="22 12 18 12 15 21 9 3 6 12 2 12"/></svg>
description: 运行轨迹：任务 → 思考 → 工具 → 文件改动 → 结果的时间线聚合视图，支持回放与节点详情。
descriptionEn: Run trajectory: task → thinking → tools → file changes → result timeline with replay and node details.

name: legado-web
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M2 3h6a4 4 0 0 1 4 4v14a3 3 0 0 0-3-3H2z"/><path d="M22 3h-6a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v14a3 3 0 0 1 3-3h7z"/></svg>
description: Legado 阅读（文本源）：搜索 / 发现 / 详情 / 目录 / 正文，书源 JSON 与安卓版兼容，可导入、检测、删废源；内置跨域+GBK 代理与本地存储，并给 AI 配了修源接口（读规则、读书源文件、逐步诊断链路、试规则验证）。
descriptionEn: Legado reader (text book sources): search / explore / info / TOC / content with Android-compatible book source JSON, plus source import and health checking. Ships its own CORS+GBK proxy, local store, and AI tools to diagnose and repair book sources.

name: 微信通道
description: 微信扫码登录（与腾讯 openclaw-weixin 同源的 ilink 协议）：出站长轮询收消息，微信里直接指挥 agent，无需公网 IP。
descriptionEn: WeChat channel (ilink protocol, same origin as Tencent openclaw-weixin): outbound long-polling, drive the agent from WeChat, no public IP needed.

name: 语音输入
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 1a3 3 0 0 0-3 3v8a3 3 0 0 0 6 0V4a3 3 0 0 0-3-3z"/><path d="M19 10v2a7 7 0 0 1-14 0v-2"/><line x1="12" y1="19" x2="12" y2="23"/><line x1="8" y1="23" x2="16" y2="23"/></svg>
description: 语音输入：输入框旁的麦克风按钮，浏览器语音识别直接听写进输入框；不支持/识别失败时自动降级为服务端转写（远端接口，或一键安装的本地 Whisper，免费不出网）。
descriptionEn: Voice input: a mic button next to the composer. Browser speech recognition dictates into the input box, with server-side transcription as automatic fallback (remote API, or one-click local Whisper that runs fully offline).

name: live-preview
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><line x1="2" y1="12" x2="22" y2="12"/><path d="M12 2a15.3 15.3 0 0 1 4 10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1-4 10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1-4-10 15.3 15.3 0 0 1 4-10z"/></svg>
description: Live Server 式预览：/liveserver 看 HTML（含相对资源与自动刷新），/md 看 Markdown 渲染；真服务只绑回环地址，经宿主通用代理对外只露同源前缀。
descriptionEn: Live-Server-style preview: HTML under /liveserver (relative assets + auto reload), rendered Markdown under /md. Loopback-only inner server exposed via host proxy prefixes.

name: image-toolkit
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2" ry="2"/><circle cx="8.5" cy="8.5" r="1.5"/><polyline points="21 15 16 10 5 21"/></svg>
description: 图片处理工作台：压缩（可按目标体积二分逼近）、裁剪、缩放、旋转/翻转、格式转换（PNG/JPEG/WebP/AVIF）、批量导出 ZIP、水印、滤镜调色、图片信息与 EXIF，可直接读写工作区图片；另给 AI 配了 4 个工具，让 agent 自己压缩/裁剪/缩放/加水印工作区里的图。
descriptionEn: Image workbench: compress (with target-size binary search), crop, resize, rotate/flip, format conversion (PNG/JPEG/WebP/AVIF), batch ZIP export, watermark, filters, image info + EXIF, and direct workspace read/write. Ships 4 AI tools so the agent can compress/crop/resize/watermark workspace images itself.

name: 笔记
description: 随手记：笔记 + 待办 + 日程提醒三合一。顶栏按钮打开可自由拖拽的全局浮窗（位置/尺寸记忆，设置也在浮窗里，无独立视图页）；提醒走服务端定时（重启不丢、错过补送），另有 5 个 AI 工具与 /note /todo /remind 快速捕获。
descriptionEn: Notes, todos and scheduled reminders in one place: a freely draggable always-on-top panel (position, size and settings all live in it, no separate view tab); reminders fire server-side (survive restarts, delivered on next open), with 5 AI tools and /note /todo /remind quick capture.

name: multi-git
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="18" r="3"/><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="3"/><circle cx="18" cy="6" r="3"/><path d="M18 9v2c0 .6-.4 1-1 1H7c-.6 0-1-.4-1-1V9"/><path d="M12 12v3"/></svg>
description: 多仓库 Git 总览：工作区内每个仓库的变更、差异、历史、分支、贮藏、跨仓搜索与时间线，另有工作区分支聚合、Fetch/Pull 与内置终端（其余只读）。
descriptionEn: Multi-repo Git overview: changes, diffs, history, branches, stashes, cross-repo search and a timeline for every repository in the workspace, plus a workspace-wide branch view, Fetch/Pull and an optional terminal.
